purpose: Concise AI-readable source-location map, not a duplicate archive

chapters.title: Ownership
chapters.rule: A7 is cross-repo catalogue; CAD repo owns drawings, edition manifests, drawing UI and CAD memory. Drive owns originals. Actions tests. Pages presents.

chapters.title: Client views
chapters.rule: Views for floor 2D/3D and selected object; Quantity Takeoff for measured item table and m/ft units; Packages for WBS/site workbenches; Sources for evidence; More for codes, guides, memory and archived editing.

chapters.title: Entity data
chapters.rule: Keep stable IDs, host wall relations, source references and provenance in machine-readable model and clicked item Technical record. Do not show provenance and internal IDs as ordinary quantity columns.

chapters.title: Architecture versions
chapters.rule: Every numbered edition is a frozen complete architectural drawing edition; never overwrite. Ashok v3.7 is final architectural version, v3.6 frozen predecessor. Structural, civil and MEP approvals separate from an architectural version.

chapters.title: Division of responsibilities
chapters.rule: Programming, calendars and Gantt belong to the distinct Scheduling & Resources project, not the drawings nav; rates and BOQ ownership belongs to the Cost Estimation repository; CAD can display source-backed geometry takeoff.

chapters.title: Publication and audit
chapters.rule: Use separate branch + PR, source privacy, browser QA, exact SHA Pages deployment and independent live readback. The GitHub history archives local edit/change-request implementation; no client-side source mutation promised.
